unlisted_practices: Evaluating chatbot responses for correction of cognitive biases (anthropomorphism, overtrust, attribution, illusion of control, fundamental attribution error, just-world hypothesis) using expert ratings
Comparing therapeutic mental health chatbots against general-purpose LLMs

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the baseline capabilities of specialized therapeutic chatbots versus general-purpose LLMs on simulated user-bot interaction scenarios representing cognitive biases, without evaluating an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
